title: Forward Open with explicit connection parameters
purpose: Drive the deeper Connection Manager service parser with a complete Forward_Open request carried through SendRRData and a connected-path payload.
expected_behavior: The receiver should traverse SendRRData, the unconnected-data item, Message Router, and Connection Manager service 0x54, then return a normal Forward_Open response or a protocol-level connection rejection for the supplied inferred parameters.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation payload length is 62 bytes and matches the CPF plus 42-byte CIP request.
CPF uses the documented Null Address Item followed by Unconnected Data Item combination.
The CIP request has service 0x54 and a two-word Connection Manager Class 0x06 Instance 0x01 path.
The Forward_Open body uses bounded connection identifiers, serial values, RPIs, parameters, and a two-word connection path.
Forward_Open body field ordering and values beyond the supplied service-code evidence are conservative model-prior assumptions, not externally verified by the supplied excerpts.
issue_safety_notes: This is a deep-parser structural analogue for the affected SendRRData family, but it does not target ForwardClose, GetConnectionData, or SearchConnectionData, and it avoids the oversized padded EPath and zero-byte request body described in issue 577.
